protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: PASS: Real CWE-863 authorization mismatch. CVE.org CVE-2026-19670 is PUBLISHED (icscert, 2026-08-18). Vendor GHSA-jr6p-63pg-hr6g and CISA ICSA-26-230-01 describe the same sink: check_rbac() pattern-matches ngx.var.request_uri (raw, percent-encoded) via ngx.re.find against path_role_envs (e.g. ^/(auth|htadmin|admin_login)), while nginx location ~* ^/(htadmin|admin_login)(\.php)\b(.*) in nginx/nginx_auth_basic_location.conf dispatches on the decoded URI. A miss takes the unmatched-path branch return ngx.HTTP_OK. On v26.07.1 (2c19ef04d85230634ac70cc68b8f418a0666afec) normalize_uri_for_rbac() only strips the query string and collapses literal /../; it never calls ngx.unescape_uri. nginx/nginx_auth_keycloak.conf invokes nginx_helpers.check_rbac after authentication. GET /%68tadmin.php therefore fails the Lua pattern and is fail-opened while nginx still routes to htadmin. GitHub Advisory Database GHSA-4887-2gc3-6j9r withdrawn_at is null; GHSA-f2v6-8cj4-mhr6 is a CNA cross-reference mix-up to an unrelated archive-bomb advisory and does not withdraw this CVE.

findings: CVE-2026-19670 remains PUBLISHED; vendor PoC GHSA-jr6p-63pg-hr6g and CISA ICSA-26-230-01 independently confirm the percent-encoded RBAC bypass with affected <=26.07.1 and fixed 26.08.0.

Source-to-sink on v26.07.1: authenticated check_rbac() -> normalize_uri_for_rbac(ngx.var.request_uri) without unescape -> ngx.re.find on path_role_envs -> fail-open ngx.HTTP_OK, while location ~* ^/(htadmin|admin_login)(\.php) serves the decoded path.

Surviving BIC is eb4e64da6da1ee764d0ac9c83e1f0a9280003211 switching check_rbac from ngx.var.uri to ngx.var.request_uri:match("^[^?]+"); parent e87c50c30d60551185305e2d045c11c3509dbda0 lacks that source.
